evidence: unreadable: At payoff@-1.8 and payoff@-0.4 the scene title reads 'why ai bots keep multi▮ying' — the 37% column and the mascot are printed straight through it, and the 37% value label collides with the same line; at seg4:mid 'COMMENT BELOW ▼' is stacked directly onto the caption 'Tell me below.'

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg4:start is a near-blank gradient (closing bubble, a title, a 2-pixel bar stub, two mascots, nothing else); by payoff@-1.8 the 2024 column and the standing mascot are drawn on top of the scene title, which now reads 'why ai bots keep multi▮ying', the 37% label lands on that same text line, and at the bottom 'COMMENT BELOW ▼' overprints the caption block — while a duplicate static clipboard mascot sits between them doing nothing.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The closing card, the scene title, the column machine, the persistent clipboard mascot and the CTA are each composited at fixed coordinates with no reserved vertical bands and no z-order/occlusion check, so the chart grows upward into the title band and the CTA is placed into the caption band; the columns also animate from zero height, leaving the scene's first seconds with nothing on screen.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Lay seg4 out in exclusive bands — closing bubble top, columns in the free mid-band sized so their tallest bar and value label clear the title (or drop the title once the closing card is up), CTA above the caption not on it — remove the duplicate idle mascot, and start the columns partially built (or pull the closing bubble in later) so seg4:start is not an empty frame.
